invariants.rationale: The style object is accessed many times in the method and must therefore be non-null before method execution.
Button state disables font color choice, but if not disabled, other font colors are considered.

invariants.expression: !isOver() || (isChecked() ? style.checkedOverFontColor != null : style.overFontColor != null) || style.fontColor != null
invariants.rationale: If the button is hovered, the relevant over font colors from style may be used, otherwise fallback to default font color.

invariants.expression: !isChecked() || ((hasKeyboardFocus() && style.checkedFocusedFontColor != null) || style.checkedFontColor != null || (isOver() && style.overFontColor != null) || style.fontColor != null)
invariants.rationale: If checked, one of the checked-specific font colors or fallback must be available.
If focused and checked, at least one relevant font color in style should be available or fallback.
